outcome.analysis: The existing brief now surfaces authenticated Environment read operations with event references and measured Control dispatch timing. Its bounded 30-item capsule contains 12 of the 14 selected-session RPC read events and reports truncation. The default capability projection returns ready at the measured size while explicitly limiting its evidence and event windows. Older records remain available through the existing cursors. This verifies exposure and bounded access for the selected session, not cross-agent discovery or effectiveness.
